profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Creative, enthusiastic and passionate about Computer Science, +16 years since I wrote my first line of code and still loving it.

I’m always learning, prototyping and contributing to the community, the time seems to go faster when you are focused in something interesting.

Specialties: Problem solving, Software Engineering, DevOps, Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
OneNote Team, contributing to build the best note-taking app.

C++, C++/WinRT, Kusto.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Helping developers to build awesome experiences with APL (Alexa Presentation Language)
https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/alexa-presentation-language/understand-apl.html

positions.title: Co-Founder, CTO
positions.description:
Carengo was the first and largest peer-to-peer car rental marketplace in Mexico. We connected people who need to rent cars with car owners using technology.

- I built the MVP that helps to got seed funding from 500 Startups LATAM (jul 2017).
- Ensure architectural integrity and consistency across the product.
- Implemented a Continuous Delivery Workflow using gitflow and the AWS DevOps Suite.
- We adopted the BDD methodology and managed the work to do with Kanban.

Stack: Node.js, React, Relay, GraphQL, Firebase, Docker, MongoDB, Cucumber, Cypress.io.

positions.title: Sr Solutions Architect
positions.description:
- Identify the appropriate software architecture based on the requirements and design elements contained in a system specification.
- Ensure architectural integrity and consistency across the products.
- Maintain periodic compilation schedule.

Stack: Mindbreeze, Node.js, Java, Firebase, Swagger, OpenWrt.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Development Lead for the Business Intelligence apartment, working side to side with the analysts in order to help them to focus on the data analysis.
- Leading a multicultural group of 6 members from different countries.
- Mentor the team in development methodologies.

Stack: PHP, MySQL, Jenkins, VBA, Java,Bash/PowerShell Scripting.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Full stack developer working within the area in charge of maintain the website for all the countries.

Stack: PHP, MyQL, Solr, Memcached, Nginx.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description: Sysadmin, GNU/Linux, servers configuration, users management, clustering
